as_told.title: Eric Walker: 'We promise not to tell'

plain: UFO researchers are said to have walked into the Penn State University office of an engineer named Eric A. Walker and asked him outright what he knew about UFOs. Michels tells it as "do you know anything about the UFO stuff," set in the 1980s. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says Walker admitted he knew about Majestic 12, an alleged secret committee set up to handle crashed UFOs. Walker said he had known about the group for 40 years. UAPGerb credits the UFO researcher William Steinman, and also names Henry Azadehdel. In one version he names the questioner as Styon and says Walker answered with a Don Quixote impersonation. Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, says he was there himself, which he puts about 30 years ago. He says that when talk turned to the committee, Walker cut the questioner off and asked, "What do you know about ESP?" ESP is extra-sensory perception, sensing things without the normal senses. Cameron says the man had no answer. Cameron also says they asked Walker whether there had ever been communication, adding "we promise not to tell." The story matters because it suggests a well-placed scientist knew of a secret UFO group and tied it to the mind.
